Hi Ava / Jordan —

Great call today — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Recap: We covered your goals for integrating Redwood to generate clinical summarization features on patient notes, embedding search across internal knowledge, and potential analytics use. Key constraints you mentioned: PHI considerations, Okta SSO, and a preference for data residency in US-east.
- Ask: To keep momentum, can you confirm the full list of stakeholders (security, legal, procurement, and business/economic buyer)? We want to make sure the right people are looped in for the security questionnaire and procurement timeline.
- Next steps (proposed):
  1) I’ll send the mutual action plan + post-call notes (attached).
  2) Security team will schedule a short intake to review the questionnaire and scope (2–3 business days).
  3) Procurement: we’ll share standard SOW template and licensing options after security scope is confirmed.

I’ve attached the call notes and MAP. Please add any missing folks and confirm whether PHI/EHR systems (Epic) are in scope so Marissa can prioritize the right docs.

Thanks —

Hi Ava / Jordan —

Thanks for the details and the questionnaire. Happy to own the security intake and kickoff. A few clarifying questions to scope the review properly:

1) Data classification & PHI: You confirmed PHI is in scope for the pilot — can you specify which PHI elements we'll encounter (e.g., full patient notes, MRN, DOB)? Also confirm whether data will be de-identified before it reaches Redwood for embeddings/processing.
2) Systems & integration surface area: You listed Epic, Snowflake, and Okta. Please confirm whether Redwood will have direct API access to Epic (via a middleware) or only to extracts pushed to Snowflake.
3) User counts & scale: Expected number of concurrent users and monthly API calls for the pilot (ballpark is fine).
4) Retention & residency: Desired retention period for embeddings and whether all data must remain in US regions.
5) Deployment preference: Do you anticipate requiring Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) or Dedicated capacity for regulatory/compliance controls, or will Hosted API suffice with contractual protections?

Proposed next steps/timeline:
- Quick intake call (30 min) this week to walk through Qs 1–4 and confirm artifacts (architecture diagram, data flow, DPA/BPA).
- We’ll return a completed vendor-side questionnaire, list of required artifacts, and an initial risk assessment within 3–5 business days after intake.

I attached our Security Questionnaire Instructions and a short checklist to help them complete the intake. Jordan — could you propose 2 times for a call?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Thanks Marissa — quick confirmations:
- PHI elements: full patient notes and MRN will be in scope for the pilot; DOB may be redacted during export.
- Integration: we'll push nightly extracts from Epic into Snowflake; Redwood will not call Epic directly for the initial pilot.
- Retention: target 90 days for embeddings during evaluation, with options to extend in production. All data must remain in US regions.
- Procurement: procurement@zenithhealth.com is the right contact for SOW and contract questions.

I can do an intake call tomorrow at 10:00am PT or Thursday at 1:00pm PT.

Jordan Patel
